## E1 step 9 addendum: the A half is now observed on the candidate line too - all three halves are candidate-anchored

The previous comment left the A half (startup policy is view-only) explicitly **unclaimed**, because its earlier record used the `Ctrl+I` entry that exists only on the unmerged PR #160 branch. It has now been taken on the same candidate-line payload - same build, same viewer actions, launched **without** `--remote-input`:

| Half | Observed | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A - startup policy is view-only | the viewer connected (`SHOWCASE_CLIENTS 1`, then `0` on disconnect: client-line delta 2) and the log holds **zero** `SHOWCASE_KEY` and **zero** `SHOWCASE_POINTER` lines - `delta KEY=0 POINTER=0` | view-only blocked remote input at startup, by both criteria, while still accepting the connection |

E1 step 9 therefore now has all three halves from the candidate-line tree, each with identical viewer actions and two independent criteria: **A blocks** (this comment), **B delivers under control mode** (previous comment: 3 key lines, 2 pointer lines), **C blocks again after the return to view-only** (previous comment: fresh client connected, zero delivery lines).

**One measurement-tooling fact worth recording**, because it cost real time and produced two apparent hangs: launching the payload with `Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput` hands the child a handle that the command runner is watching, so the launching command does not return until the application exits - up to 120-300 s - and reads as a stall. Launching it detached instead (`Popen` with its own file handles plus `DETACHED_PROCESS`) returns immediately. Tooling that measures an application must never hold the runner open for that application's lifetime. A related trap from the same runs: counters must be read from the log of the instance being measured, never carried in a state file across an application restart, which is what produced an earlier `delta KEY=-6` reading.

**Still owed on this cell**: the held-state balance across the transition (this payload has no key probe, and adding one to the frozen candidate was declined). The E2/E3 disable paths and the DPR interaction cell also remain open; DPR needs a scaled or multi-display host.
